name: Sabor Bajero (Familias Emprendedoras programme, Alianza Team + Alcaldía de Barranquilla)
verifyNote: Recurring street food festival of Barrio Abajo cooks, run by the company Alianza Team with the Mayor's Office. Last seen active 2025 (year precision; stored as its first day) — https://www.oecd-events.org/oecd-local-development-forum-2025/partner/a5ef4528-6658-f011-8f7c-6045bd96bdd0/familias-emprendedoras-sabor-bajero.

name: IPES - Instituto para la Economía Social (Bogotá; runs Fritanga Fest and the street vendor programmes)
verifyNote: Not a network: a public agency (Bogotá's street-vendor institute) — the address is its official correspondence intake, not a partnership contact (research, 16 Nov 2026). A public agency, not a trade body. It organises the 7th Fritanga Fest (2-4 Oct 2026) and the fairs and commercial points for informal street vendors. Worth approaching as a channel to street food traders, but expect public-sector procedures. Last seen active 2026-10-01 — https://radionacional.co/cultura/gastronomia/fritanga-fest-2026-en-bogota-fechas-precios-y-lugares.
members: 55-70 establishments per Fritanga Fest edition (bogota.gov.co, 2025); also keeps the city's informal street vendor register (RIVI)
